arStrings.szText: The Garden of Akarat
Even after Mephisto's defeat, something dark yet lingers among the followers of Akarat.
I have rescued the pilgrim Bnatros from the Morlu. He says the others of his company were taken to a place called the Garden of Akarat. I must hunt down Bnators' captors to learn more.
Obtain a clue from a corrupted pilgrim
Bnatros and I have discovered the location of the Garden of Akarat. We must gain entry to rescue Adoné and the other pilgrims.

Speak with Bnatros

I found Bnatros in Atanos, but so have the Morlu. Demons prowl this cursed land. Why? And what has become of the other pilgrims? I must defeat the Morlu before I can learn more from Bnatros about what happened.
Defeat the Morlu
The pilgrims Bnatros and Adoné are determined to travel to Atanos, the last place Akarat was seen. Such a journey will be fraught with danger. I should seek them out and make sure they are safe.
